findings.explanation: IV cho AES-256-GCM bi hardcode thanh buffer 12 byte toan so 0 thay vi sinh moi bang crypto.randomBytes(12) cho moi lan ma hoa. Moi loi goi encryptCredential() voi cung mot masterKey deu tao ra cung mot cap (key, IV) nen day khong phai edge case ma la loi xay ra o MOI lan ma hoa. Voi GCM, tai su dung (key, IV) pha vo hoan toan tinh bao mat: no lo XOR cua cac plaintext ma hoa boi cung key (lo keystream), va tai su dung nonce nhieu lan cho phep khoi phuc GHASH authentication key (forbidden attack), tu do gia mao duoc ciphertext hop le va bo qua auth tag. Fix: sinh iv = crypto.randomBytes(12) moi lan goi encryptCredential va van luu kem ciphertext nhu code da lam (base64UrlEncode(iv) o dong 39) — phan luu tru da dung, chi phan sinh IV la sai.
